examples.title: Hover, focus and touch
examples.description: Compose a named trigger. The tooltip supports hover and keyboard focus, and a tap toggle on a coarse non-hover pointer.

examples.title: All sides
examples.description: top, right, bottom and left are placement requests. The popup can reposition near the viewport edge.

examples.title: Optional arrow
examples.description: TooltipArrow follows the content surface. sideOffset changes the gap from the trigger.

examples.title: Light surface
examples.description: TooltipContent variant="light" is an optional v2 surface; the default stays dark. TooltipArrow inherits the content surface automatically.

examples.title: Controlled visibility
examples.description: open and onOpenChange let the parent own visibility. Escape or an outside interaction requests closing.

examples.title: Custom opening delay
examples.description: delayDuration on the provider or individual root overrides the inherited delay.

examples.title: Wrapped help
examples.description: Keep tooltip copy short and non-interactive. Critical information should remain visible in the page.
